title: Yellow Canadian Chickpea Curry
description: A creamy and bitter Canadian dish featuring chickpeas, this curry is a show-off recipe that is low-carb-friendly and made in a wok. It is a unique blend of flavors and textures that will impress your guests.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a wok over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chickpeas, coconut milk, yellow mustard, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for another minute.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
